prompt: A gaunt necromancer in tattered black robes stands in three-quarter view facing south-west, arms outstretched, drawing two streams of glowing crimson lifeforce into his chest. One ribbon of crimson life-energy is torn out of a withering, hunched green beast collapsing to his left; a second crimson ribbon is siphoned from a doubled-over peasant clutching his chest to the right. The necromancer straightens, his greyish drained flesh flushing healthier as the life pours in. The only source of light is the crimson glow of the streaming lifeforce. The background is a desolate ash-grey graveyard at dusk.
